Quick troubleshooting note and new invite from ops:

Root cause: The original calendar metadata contained a "conference=auto" flag which, for certain GSuite-to-GSuite flows, forces Google Calendar to replace the conference link with a Meet link on the recipient side. That can also cause a TZ shift if the ICS didn't include explicit TZID fields.

What I did:
- Created a Zoom meeting: https://redwood-inference.zoom.us/j/987654321 (passcode: 4mT9Xr)
- Generated a deterministic ICS that includes the Zoom join URL and explicit TZ (DTSTART;TZID=America/Los_Angeles). Attached as redwood_demo_zoom.ics.
- Added dial-in numbers (US +1 669 900 6833) and the meeting passcode in the invite body so phone users can join without digging through the conference tool.

Please accept the new invite (I sent it from infra-calendar@redwood.ai — some clients see a second event; you can decline the old one if needed). I also stripped the conference=auto flag to prevent Meet substitution.

New invite details (for copy/paste):

When: Thu, Mar 18, 2026 10:00 AM Pacific Time (US and Canada)
Join Zoom Meeting: https://redwood-inference.zoom.us/j/987654321
